name: Sling Shot Bench Press (Barbell)
instructions: Put the sling shot on your upper arms and lie on a bench.
Grip the bar and retract your shoulder blades.
Lower the bar to your chest.
Press up with the band's assistance.
longevityNotes: Pressing strength keeps daily pushing — doors, shelves, getting up from the floor — easy and safe. Controlled pressing builds the shoulders, chest, and arms that protect you in a fall.
overview: A bench press using a sling-shot device that assists the bottom of the lift.
